acs.AC-001.1: WHEN an authorized Project Manager loads the Review Queue, THE system SHALL return only Pending review Solution Form tickets in Projects they currently manage, ordered by earliest review due date by default.
acs.AC-001.2: WHEN the Project Manager filters by Project or changes page or supported column sort, THE system SHALL apply the filter and paging on the server and retain the list state in the frontend URL.
acs.AC-001.3: WHEN the Project Manager selects all tickets, THE system SHALL select all eligible ticket IDs matching the current Project filter across pages.
acs.AC-001.4: IF the queue is empty or cannot load, THEN THE frontend SHALL show MSG13 for an empty queue or the API's SRS error code with a retry action for a failed query.
acs.AC-001.5: IF the requester is unauthenticated, is not a Project Manager, or requests an unmanaged Project, THEN THE backend SHALL deny the request without returning that Project's ticket data.
acs.AC-002.1: WHEN the Project Manager approves eligible Pending review tickets, THE system SHALL set each ticket to Published, save one decision per ticket and remove those tickets from the queue.
acs.AC-002.2: WHEN two or more tickets are approved from the queue, THE frontend SHALL require confirmation using MSG19 before sending the mutation and show MSG14 after success.
acs.AC-002.3: WHEN one ticket is approved from the queue or Ticket Detail, THE frontend SHALL submit that decision without the bulk confirmation and show MSG14 after success.
acs.AC-002.5: WHEN a Project Manager approves a ticket they wrote, THE system SHALL allow the decision and retain both writer and reviewer identity in history.
acs.AC-003.1: WHEN the Project Manager rejects one or several eligible tickets, THE frontend SHALL show MSG15 and require one reason for the entire selection.
acs.AC-003.2: WHEN rejection succeeds, THE system SHALL set each ticket to Rejected, persist its reason and decision, remove it from the queue and show MSG16.
acs.AC-003.3: IF the rejection reason is missing or whitespace-only or exceeds 1,000 characters, THEN THE system SHALL return the corresponding MSG01 or MSG02 field error and preserve ticket state and the open popup.
acs.AC-003.4: IF a Rejected ticket is submitted for another review decision, THEN THE backend SHALL reject the transition without changing it or returning it to the queue or Published results.
acs.AC-004.1: WHEN the Project Manager selects one, several or all eligible Pending review Solution Form tickets in the Review Queue or opens one eligible ticket in Ticket Detail, THE frontend SHALL offer one Request changes form whose comment applies to every selected ticket and SHALL show Solution and saved Evidence references read-only in Ticket Detail.
acs.AC-004.2: WHEN a valid change comment is submitted for selected eligible tickets, THE system SHALL atomically set every selected ticket to Changes requested, save the same comment and one decision per ticket, preserve each stored review due date, remove those tickets from the queue and show MSG17.
acs.AC-004.3: IF the comment is missing or whitespace-only or exceeds 1,000 characters, THEN THE system SHALL return MSG01 or MSG02 and preserve ticket state and the popup.
acs.AC-004.4: IF a change request includes any ticket that did not come from the Solution Form, THEN THE backend SHALL reject the entire request without changes and THE frontend SHALL use MSG18 to explain the source restriction where applicable.
acs.AC-005.1: IF any selected ticket is missing, outside the reviewer's managed Projects, or no longer Pending review, THEN THE backend SHALL reject the entire decision request without partial writes.
acs.AC-005.2: WHEN any decision succeeds, THE system SHALL persist the actor, action, ticket resource, decision time, writer and reason/comment as applicable, with one append-only history record and one AuditService.record call per ticket in the same transaction.
acs.AC-005.3: IF persistence fails or concurrent requests attempt to decide the same ticket, THEN THE system SHALL allow at most one successful decision per Pending review state and SHALL roll back failed requests completely.
acs.AC-005.4: WHEN a decision succeeds, THE system SHALL preserve the saved Solution, Evidence, Jira issue status and stored review due date.
acs.AC-005.5: IF a decision payload is empty or contains invalid or repeated ticket IDs, THEN THE backend SHALL reject it before writing any decision records.
acs.AC-005.6: WHEN a Published-ticket consumer queries the review service, THE system SHALL expose only Published tickets within the authorization scope supplied by the trusted integration.
acs.AC-005.7: WHEN an actor reads a ticket within their trusted Project access scope, THE backend SHALL return an unpublished ticket only to its author or a Project Manager managing that Project, and SHALL return only Published tickets to other readers; IF a reader requests an unpublished ticket they neither manage nor authored, THEN THE backend SHALL return 404 MSG04 without its content or review comment.
acs.AC-005.8: IF any review decision contains more than 500 ticket IDs, THEN THE backend SHALL return 400 MSG06 before acquiring ticket locks or writing records, and THE frontend SHALL disable all decision actions and show guidance to select at most 500 tickets; WHEN Select all exceeds that limit, THE frontend SHALL retain the complete selection until the user narrows it, without splitting it into partially committed requests.
acs.AC-006.1: WHEN the backend determines reviewer identity or Project rights, THE system SHALL obtain them exclusively from a trusted server-side auth/Project interface and SHALL ignore client-supplied actor or management claims.
acs.AC-006.2: IF the auth/Project integration is absent or cannot verify access, THEN THE module SHALL deny review access without a default reviewer or permissive fallback.
acs.AC-006.3: WHEN a ticket is rejected or changes are requested, THE system SHALL save one pending email handoff per ticket containing recipient identity, decision, reason/comment and decision reference in the same transaction, without sending network email inside the transaction.
acs.AC-006.4: IF the external email integration is unavailable, THEN THE system SHALL retain the committed decision and its pending notification without claiming delivery; the integration contract SHALL require the sender to log errors and retry at most three times within one hour under GBR-27.
acs.AC-006.5: WHEN the frontend operates with mocking disabled, THE review UI SHALL use the generated real review endpoints and SHALL handle loading, empty, error and mutation-pending states.
acs.AC-006.6: WHEN implementation is delivered, THE integration documentation SHALL identify auth, Project rights, ticket submission, Evidence retrieval, mail delivery/retry and downstream search/triage/chatbot integration as external prerequisites and distinguish automated contract tests from a complete live test.
acs.AC-006.7: WHEN a user without the Project Manager role reads Ticket Detail, THE frontend SHALL hide navigation to the Review Queue.
